scope: Six unflagged NIH ingredient-group query matches across four already-reviewed source abstracts. Query-role annotations only, not new drugs, new outer coverage or independent replication.

source_snapshot.note: Missing literal name crossrefs do not imply no existing appraisal; Bletilla extract already appraised.

records.role: Infectious organism in an adverse clinical course; not administered probiotic or ingredient treatment.

query_roles.role: Genus substring of the reported Enterococcus faecium infection.
Named infection organism, no probiotic administration reported.

records.actual_intervention: TCR-alpha-beta/CD19-depleted matched-unrelated-donor hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation with treosulfan-based reduced-intensity conditioning.
records.model: Single 11-year-old boy with BUB1B-MVA1 and myelodysplastic syndrome.
records.material_positive: Initial engraftment/complete hematologic recovery and no severe early toxicity reported.
records.null_or_adverse: Graft rejection day +47 followed by prolonged pancytopenia and multi-organ E. faecium sepsis; death day +156. No sustained rescue.
records.bub1b_relevance: MVA1 genotype is the clinical background; neither microbial treatment nor BUBR1 restoration demonstrated.
records.identity_limit: Cannot transfer this infection report to a specific probiotic strain, preparation, or supplement efficacy/safety claim.
records.controls_exposure_limit: Uncontrolled single case; abstract is not an E. faecium treatment experiment.
records.existing_review: Complete saved abstract reviewed previously; clinical-case/transient-recovery-then-failure annotation reused.
records.followup_decision: No new primary qualification needed to reject a probiotic-benefit interpretation of this match; preserve case-context annotation.

records.role: Actual botanical-extract treatment; group/genus label does not specify the experimental preparation.

query_roles.role: Genus term within Bletilla striata extract (BSE), the administered mixture.

records.actual_intervention: Bletilla striata extract (BSE), not a purified constituent or a specified commercial Bletilla product.
records.model: Ovariectomized rats and RANKL-induced osteoclast differentiation.
records.material_positive: Reported significant decrease in rat bone loss by micro-CT/pathology, inhibition of osteoclast formation/differentiation and F-actin rings, and lower NFATc1/CTSK/MMP-9 markers.
records.null_or_adverse: No null or adverse outcome described in this abstract; that is not a comprehensive safety or null-results assessment.
records.bub1b_relevance: BUB1B is one of four key targets in a combined thermal-proteome/virtual-screening response network. Abstract does not establish BUBR1 protein restoration, direction, checkpoint rescue, or BUB1B necessity for bone protection.
records.identity_limit: Phenanthrene dimers and steroids are ingredient classes implicated by the network; abstract does not establish a purified compound causing the in vivo effect. Separate coelonin work cannot identify this extract or its causal ingredient.
records.controls_exposure_limit: Abstract does not provide exact preparation, dose, time course, group sizes, effect sizes or full control results. Thermal-stability fold change >2 is an author target-selection criterion, not independently confirmed binding or causality here.
records.existing_review: Existing new-bletilla-extract appraisal in decisions.json and lead-qualification.md already covers this PMID; prior 2026-09-21 check read PubMed abstract and author-institution release, with subscription full text unavailable/ScienceDirect 403.
records.followup_decision: Retain the existing mixture-level reserve and inherited primary-access follow-up. Link the semantic genus/extract relationship for discovery only; do not create a second appraisal or claim chemical equivalence.

records.role: Computational drug candidate from transcriptome/network analysis; not administered treatment.

query_roles.role: One of ten small-molecule candidates ranked by P values.

records.model: Secondary analysis of COVID-19 whole-blood/PBMC and HIV whole-blood GEO datasets.
records.material_positive: 394 common differentially expressed genes and chromosome/cell-cycle enrichment reported; BUB1B among ten ranked hub genes. This is analytical association, not resveratrol efficacy.
records.null_or_adverse: No resveratrol treatment outcome, positive or null, tested in the abstract.
records.bub1b_relevance: Hub-gene co-occurrence does not demonstrate that resveratrol targets BUB1B or restores BUBR1.
records.identity_limit: The name resveratrol is an identified candidate label; dose, isomer, formulation and delivered exposure were not established because no intervention is reported.
records.controls_exposure_limit: No drug-treated controls, functional rescue or MVA model described.
records.followup_decision: No new primary efficacy qualification warranted solely from this prediction. Keep as computational background, no treatment or MVA-benefit credit.

records.role: Actual formulated curcumin treatment in cancer cells; the broad polyphenol term is a class description.

query_roles.role: Title phrase refers to gemini nanoparticle curcumin (Gemini-Cur), not free curcumin or every nano-curcumin product.
Class descriptor in the title of the same Gemini-Cur experiment; not a second intervention or generic-polyphenol efficacy.

records.material_positive: Cytotoxicity and apoptosis reported; 3,892 DEGs at adjusted P<0.01, with 442 having absolute log2 fold change >2. Five central genes including BUB1B showed significant modulation confirmed by PCR/Western blot relative to non-treated cells.
records.null_or_adverse: The measured functional direction is cancer-cell viability inhibition/apoptosis. Abstract does not describe normal-cell rescue, normal-cell selectivity or MVA benefit; no null results are reported there.
records.bub1b_relevance: BUB1B modulation in treated cancer cells is reported, but its direction, causal contribution and distinction from cytotoxic cell-cycle changes are not supplied in the abstract.
records.identity_limit: Do not transfer the result to dietary turmeric, unformulated curcumin, all nanoparticles or unspecified polyphenols. The two NIH rows describe one formulation experiment.
records.controls_exposure_limit: Non-treated comparison specified. Dose, duration, vehicle/empty-carrier controls, formulation composition and healthy-cell controls not provided in abstract.
records.existing_review: Existing complete-abstract Gemini-Cur cytotoxicity/formulation annotation reused; prior review did not require primary follow-up.
records.followup_decision: No new MVA-oriented nomination or mandatory follow-up from this abstract. A future mechanism/formulation check would require full-text direction, carrier controls and normal-cell selectivity; not undertaken here.
